task_name: Cutover and restore scripts plus checklist
audit_input_note: T17 deliverables are git-ignored host files; audited by content hash, not git range. Phase-5 bounded recovery fix to P5-F5 (final-dump freshness guard) audited; all four hashes matched the controller values (cutover-ggf.sh is 848 lines).

concerns_addressed: Hashes: all four files re-hashed and matched. Gate under the shim: bash -n, shellcheck, dry-run, no-flag, restore dry-run and self-check all pass (77 ok lines, matching the printed count); calls.log stayed 0 bytes. No remote command is reachable without --execute (no Critical): rcmd, rout, lrun, remote_test_f and get_var are gated; the new container_identity and guard reads go through rout/get_var.

P5-F5 path 1 (final dump fails, then --from-phase f): final_backup.done is absent, assert_final_dump_fresh dies at point 1 before the snapshot. Path 2 (supersede mv ok, fresh dump fails): the marker is removed and final_backup_file is set to empty (or, if rm failed, the generation differs from the new stop_gen), so the guard dies. Path 3 (point-1 recovery reopens the site, manual stop, resume at f): the Id changes on force-recreate, StartedAt/FinishedAt change on a manual restart-and-stop, and the maintenance flag is checked; each dies at point 1 with 're-run --from-phase d'. Self-check drives the real phase_f for each condition.
restore-ggf.sh --dry-run on a *.superseded-* path exits 2 (also with a trailing component); gate dump still refused.

Mutations on scratchpad copies all make self-check exit 1: (k') guard call removed -> several FAILs; (m') identity compare removed -> 'container identity changed' FAIL (1 failed, 76 ok); (p) restore accepts superseded -> restore refusal FAIL (1 failed, 76 ok).

No false-fail on the normal first run: the identity is read after compose stop and the 'no container running' assertion; compose stop keeps the container (Id unchanged) and FinishedAt is written once at stop. A resume at f in the same window (including a retry after a clean rc 1 merge, where merge_started is cleared) keeps identity, flag, file and generation, so it passes.

The identity value survives the state round trip: it is written inside single quotes in the remote shell (the '|' is not interpreted) and read with grep '^name=' | tail -n 1 | cut -d= -f2-; the value has no '=' and a local simulation returned it byte-identical. No set -u hazard: the remote strings use only fixed variables, and the inspect template and test strings are single-quoted or escaped. The guard sits in the else branch of the merge/merge_started tests, so it never blocks a post-merge resume (merge.done present) and merge_started still dies at point 2 first.

Earlier fixes intact (self-check cases pass): rc 255 and the ERR trap, merge_started clear on clean rc 1, dist swap without && chain, deletion ban, final dump after the stop, gate dump refused, stop-generation reuse and supersede.

strengths: The guard is fail-closed on every condition (marker, non-empty matching generation, non-superseded non-empty file, maintenance flag, container identity) and gives each a specific point-1 message with the --from-phase d command.
Container identity of Id|StartedAt|FinishedAt catches recreate, restart, and restart-then-stop, which a single field would miss.
Self-check now drives the real phase_f with stubbed state for each guard branch and the three claimed mutations were each caught.

issues.description: New. phase_e records stop_container_id from container_identity() inside a command substitution used as an argument, so a failed docker inspect is swallowed and an empty identity is written. The run continues through the final dump and only phase f's guard then dies (fail-safe, but late and with a generic message). Check that the identity is non-empty in phase e and die there.

Reduced. The supersede is still 'mv file file.superseded-<ts> && rm -f marker' in one remote call. If mv succeeds and rm fails, the marker and final_backup_file still name a path that no longer exists; the guard now refuses this safely, but a re-run through phase e then fails at the mv until the marker is cleared by hand. Remove the marker first, or tolerate a missing source.

Carried forward, unfixed. The disk re-check aborts silently on failure (no free-space/required message) and stat -c%s and df -Pm are GNU-dependent (fails closed). The 2x gate dump + 64 MB threshold is not tied to the real post-merge need. T18 should confirm on the host.

Carried forward, unfixed. A .partial is removed only on a normal failure of the dump chain; if ssh drops mid-dump the next run uses a new timestamp and the old .partial stays. Remove stale camel-pre-merge-<date>-final-*.partial files (only that pattern) at the start of the final dump.

Carried forward, unfixed. The automatic merge_started clear and the 'nothing is committed' wording treat every rc other than 0 and 255 as a clean rollback, including rc >= 128 (signal-killed ssh, OOM kill) and an rc 1 from a COMMIT whose acknowledgement was lost. Treat rc >= 128 like 255 and leave the marker.

Carried forward, unfixed. Dry-run prints 'sub_mark merge_started' after the merge command line, but --execute writes it before the merge. The dry-run listing order is inverted relative to the real run.
Carried forward, unfixed. self_check assigns globals (rc, got, code, swap_script, FRC, stop_ln, fin_ln, gen_ln, id_ln, rec) instead of locals; harmless while self-check exits but fragile if reused.

Carried forward, unfixed. Phase b's row-count equality against LIVE data while the site still serves traffic can false-abort (card_events grows on every mutation). Consider requiring cards and tracker_items equal and restored events <= live.

Carried forward, unfixed. The terminate, rename-aside and rename-new steps are separate -c transactions; an interruption between them leaves no database under the production name and the re-run's first rename fails, contradicting 'every step is re-runnable'.
Carried forward, unfixed. Phase c's 'test -e <copy> || sudo cp -a ...' leaves a partial copy that later counts as present if cp is interrupted; the same for the compose backup copy on the next line.

Carried forward, unfixed. '--from-phase' or '--date' as the last argument hits a bare second shift and exits through the ERR trap with an unhelpful message; '--from-phase ' silently behaves as no flag. MIN_FREE_MB=1024 vs about 846 MB free means preflight aborts today (correct fail-safe, T18 item).
